name: muse
specialty: Headless terminal agent for implementation and review from a prompt file.
notes: Login: muse login (interactive; the harness never runs it). Status: muse --version. Headless: muse exec [--model <id>] [--json] [--prompt-file PATH] [--permission-profile ID] [--workspace PATH] [PROMPT].

API error 402 (Billing verification failed) and API error 429 (Subscription quota exhausted, with a reset time) mean unavailable (billing/quota): drop muse for this run and reassign the seat; never count it as a failed builder or review. Pipe its output to roster.py classify with --exit-code; only a non-zero exit whose last 20 lines hold the error line counts.
A tiny prompt can pass while a long task then hits 429, so classify every dispatch's output, not just the probe.
